compact_view_synthesis.description: Novel-view synthesis on the paper's Tanks&Temples (train, truck) and Deep Blending (drjohnson, playroom) scenes: reconstruct each scene as a 3D Gaussian representation from its training views and render the held-out views (every 8th view, the paper's protocol), with as few Gaussians as possible. Paper Tables 1-5 (main comparison, per-scene breakdowns).
compact_view_synthesis.notes: Paper numbers ('results') are means over the same four scenes, taken from the per-scene Tables 2-5 (3DGS, SteepGS) and the per-dataset Table 1 (3DGS + Thres., mean of the T&T and DB dataset means). The paper trains at the released image resolution on 7/8 of the views; this gym trains at half that resolution on 6/8 of the views (every 8th view is the held-out test set exactly as in the paper, the views at index 4 mod 8 are a validation set scored by eval/train). Absolute PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS are therefore not on exactly the paper's scale (half resolution typically raises PSNR); num_points_ratio is scale-free. num_points_ratio = Gaussians / Gaussians of the evaluator-fixed 3DGS-ADC reference on the same scene, averaged over scenes; the paper's value is computed from Table 5. Feasibility (evaluator-fixed, see eval/test/protocol.json): at most 0.65x the ADC reference's Gaussians per scene, PSNR >= ADC-2 dB, SSIM >= ADC-0.06, LPIPS <= ADC+0.10 per scene; a failed run gets the worst value of every metric. Coefficients: quality (PSNR 1.0, SSIM 0.5, LPIPS 0.5) and compactness (1.0) reflect the paper's claim of fewer Gaussians without sacrificing rendering quality.

psnr.description: Mean over scenes of the per-view PSNR (dB) of the re-rendered representation against the held-out ground-truth views.

ssim.description: Mean over scenes of per-view SSIM (11x11 Gaussian window) against the held-out views.

lpips.description: Mean over scenes of per-view LPIPS (VGG-16, v0.1) against the held-out views.

num_points_ratio.description: Number of Gaussians in the submitted representation divided by the evaluator-fixed Gaussian count of the standard 3DGS adaptive-density-control reference on the same scene, averaged over scenes (compactness).

_paper_per_scene.source: Tables 2-5 of the paper (full released resolution, 7/8 training views)
